records.response_pred: Hmm, let's see. I'd say we should've moved south a day earlier. The swamp wasn't as dangerous as we thought, and it provided us with water. records.utterance: First thing when I get back — I'm going to compile all the resource data from these five days into a report.

records.response_pred: Practical purpose, you say? None that I'm aware of. DaVinci has always had this... compulsion to draw, to capture the beauty around him.
